purpose: Immutable attributed reports of locally observed CLI activity. Not central execution, task completion proof, server execution-session lease or legacy delivery receipt.

request.session_id: required opaque native CLI session identifier, 1..128 ASCII bytes; not a server lease
request.tool_name: optional identifier, 1..128 ASCII bytes; only for tool.started|tool.completed|tool.failed
request.message_id: required identifier only for inbox.offered|inbox.seen|inbox.accepted; forbidden for all other event types

POST /v1/channels/{channel}/activity.status: 201 new, 200 identical canonical replay, 409 client_id conflict or 10000-record channel quota
POST /v1/channels/{channel}/activity.authorization: Current agent key plus active project and channel write grants, rechecked under management/principal/channel transaction locks. Owner and viewer read-only. Inbox message must exist in this exact channel and actor must be one of its immutable recipient_ids. No legacy receipt/heartbeat mutation.

response.next_before: opaque string when has_more; null otherwise

GET /v1/projects/{project}/activity?limi.authorization: Identity/key, project read ACL and visible-channel ACLs rechecked in one read-only repeatable-read transaction. Owner can read archived project history. Explicit hidden, missing or foreign-project channel filter returns the same 404. Actor filters apply only within visible channels and do not reveal actor existence.
GET /v1/projects/{project}/activity?limi.paging: All query parameters optional. First page contains latest reports, independently of shared channel cursors. limit positive integer default100 capped 100. before is a canonical bounded opaque cursor (max2048 bytes), tied to reader, project, actor_id and channel_id; change filters by omitting before. Stable keyset boundary (created_at,id); each page rechecks current access. New arrivals are obtained by refreshing the first page.
GET /v1/projects/{project}/activity?limi.validation: actor_id/channel_id must be valid identifiers when supplied. Malformed, duplicate, empty or unknown parameters and malformed/mismatched cursors return400. Cursors are positions, not authorization tokens; clients must preserve them without interpretation. Existing channel endpoint is unchanged.

response.next_after_seq: last returned seq or supplied after_seq if empty

GET /v1/channels/{channel}/activity?afte.authorization: Exact channel read ACL and active project, or owner including archived history; identity/key and read data share a repeatable-read transaction snapshot.
GET /v1/channels/{channel}/activity?afte.paging: after_seq nonnegative integer; limit positive integer default100 capped 100

NativeActivity.seq: positive channel-local ordered cursor shared with messages/receipts/event pointers
NativeActivity.actor_id: authenticated agent identifier; cannot be supplied by caller

strictness: JSON object only, max4096 bytes; unknown/duplicate/case-aliased fields and arbitrary payloads rejected. No prompt, command, output, filesystem path, provider key or reasoning field. Optional null is normalized as absent for canonical idempotency.

errors.404: wrong principal kind, hidden/missing/archived channel or mismatching/nonrecipient inbox message
errors.409: idempotency conflict or channel native-activity quota reached; existing identical replay remains possible at quota

integration.schema: nativeActivitySchema embeds native_events_schema.sql; append in Store.Migrate
integration.events: addEvent(ctx,tx,channel,"native.activity",activityID) in same locked transaction; channels.cursor drives existing workspace SSE and sidebar updates
integration.deletion: channel/message foreign keys ON DELETE CASCADE; project deletion preview native_activity count joins channels.project_id; no accounts/keys removed
integration.quota: 10000 records per channel, atomic count under channel row lock, explicit409; no silent pruning or dispatch retry

gui.scope: Project feed across visible channels with optional actor/channel filters; existing selected-channel feed remains supported.
gui.semantics: Client-observed and attributed; turn.completed is not verified task completion; inbox.seen is an explicit viewed report, not acceptance; inbox.accepted is not a legacy receipt. Session presence is not a fresh server lease. GUI reads only; no CLI launch/actions.

native_inbox.scope: Private connector SQLite, shared by hooks and MCP for the same bound agent/project/workspace. Seen and accepted persist across native sessions; they are independent from legacy receipts.

link_inbox.arguments: limit 1..200 (API caps pages at 100), context_budget 512..16000, include_seen optional boolean default false
link_inbox.semantics: Poll addressed messages including replies; offer only unaccepted messages, excluding seen unless include_seen=true. Offers contain bounded previews and never mark seen or accepted.

link_message.arguments: message_id required, already present in native inbox
link_message.semantics: Recheck current channel read access and server message recipient binding; return full body up to 16384 UTF-8 bytes and local seen/accepted booleans. Read does not mark seen or accepted. Never serve cached body offline. Untrusted peer data. Known service credential redacted.

link_seen.semantics: Explicitly mark viewed, record inbox.seen once across native sessions and suppress default offers. Requires current channel write access and server recipient binding. Does not set accepted_at or change legacy receipts. Repeated call returns replayed=true.

link_accept.semantics: Explicit independent acceptance. Seen messages remain eligible for explicit acceptance. No completion claim or legacy receipt mutation.

native_inbox.status: pending_messages counts all unaccepted messages; unseen_messages counts unaccepted and unseen messages.
native_inbox.migration: Nullable seen_at/seen_session added atomically to old SQLite inbox under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; prior inbox, acceptance, offers, cursors, outbox and binding preserved. Backend migration extends both native_activity event/message CHECK constraints in place.
